findingsFixed.rootCause: First-nonempty auto-fit keyed off node array length and a per-message first flag. Placeholder nodes without finite x/y consumed the transition, so a later layout with real coordinates never fitted. The same flag could be spent while graphType was still network.
findingsFixed.impact: Empty Temporal bootstrap could stay at the default {x:0,y:0,k:1} camera after nodes became drawable.
findingsFixed.change: Fit when the first finite-coordinate temporal nodes appear (hasFittedTemporalView), skip non-finite nodes in fitView, reset the flag on empty diffs and when leaving temporal mode.

findingsFixed.rootCause: Radio uncheck clicked a checked radio and returned ok. HTML radios do not uncheck that way. Fill/type on buttons also returned ok without changing value.
findingsFixed.impact: Agents could record a passing uncheck/fill/type while the control was unchanged.
findingsFixed.change: Radio uncheck and fill/type on non-editable controls return wrongControl. Check/uncheck also fail if the checked state does not match after click.

findingsFixed.rootCause: Yarn extra args were appended without `--`, so `yarn run <script> --features prebase-testing` is parsed as Yarn flags.
findingsFixed.impact: Tauri testing launches through Yarn Classic fail instead of reaching the package script.
findingsFixed.change: Yarn with extra args now emits `run <script> -- --features prebase-testing`. Yarn with no extra args still omits `--`.

findingsFixed.rootCause: Every Windows package manager resolved to `.cmd`. Bun ships as bun.exe. Yarn extra args with `--` were rejected because Yarn was assumed never to use a separator.
findingsFixed.impact: Windows Bun launches miss the real binary. Yarn `--features prebase-testing` after `--` was illegally rejected.
findingsFixed.change: Windows Bun resolves to bun.exe. Yarn accepts optional `--` before the allowlisted extra args; npm/pnpm/bun still require `--`.

findingsFixed.rootCause: Enable Tauri Testing always rewrote Cargo, Rust, and capabilities even when preview listed only a subset. applyCapabilitiesTestingPermission pretty-prints, so an already-correct capability file was reformatted.
findingsFixed.impact: Unrelated capability JSON could change during a cargo-only enable, and rollback covered writes that should not have happened.
findingsFixed.change: Write only files whose content actually changes, and write capabilities only when preview.changes includes that path.

findingsRejected.why: runtimeEditor.ts plus handleRuntimePreviewStatusMessage already connect on load and successful probe, ignore probe failure, and disconnect only on error. Changing that would reintroduce failed-fetch disconnects.

Detector already reports supportsBackendApiAccess: false. Setup injects only tauri-plugin-wdio-webdriver. hasWdioPlugin remains as a detection signal that the unused crate does not count as full-native setup.

Tests and the thin-W3C intent keep a WebDriver-only capability that does not replace core:default. Expanding setup to patch tauri.conf.json is out of scope. Remaining risk: a brand-new default.json is not auto-linked in tauri.conf.json.
Retrying those codes matches notFound: options can appear or enable within the action timeout. wrongControl already fails immediately.
Current tests treat Control+A with extra modifiers as select-all. Tightening that would fight the locked contract without a production failure.
hasWdioPlugin is still asserted in detector tests. scriptDetector and managedRendererCommand runPrefix functions return different prefixes and are not unused duplicates.

commands.detail: First run 23 passing / 1 failing (placeholder auto-fit test used VM-realm deepEqual). After test fix and network-mode fit reset: graphEditorProductionWebview 10/10 passing. Neighboring workbenchTemporalViewService 14/14 passing on the first run.
10 passing after finite-coordinate auto-fit test correction and hasFittedTemporalView network reset.
107 passing (desktop automation, package-manager argv, session restart/inspect, Tauri/Electron detectors, Runtime Preview reachability).

remainingRisks: Created Tauri capability files with identifier prebase-testing are not registered in tauri.conf.json; Enable Testing on an app with no capabilities file may not grant WebDriver ACL.
Synthetic KeyboardEvents are not trusted; CSS :hover and some native shortcuts still need a pointer/WebDriver backend.
no-cors probe success is opacity-only reachability, not an HTTP status check. Load still connects on browser error pages by design.
Graph getSnapshot watchdog still times out in the unit harness (pre-existing); live GUI Temporal/Runtime/Tauri evidence remains in phase-3.18 acceptance, not this review.
